# Fiverr

> > Fiverr is a global freelance marketplace connecting businesses with freelancers across digital services, featuring Fiverr Pro for vetted talent, Fiverr Enterprise for large organizations, and specialized tools like LogoMaker.

The platform offers tiered services from standard freelancers to Fiverr Certified professionals, with dedicated Business Success Managers and Project Partners for enterprise clients. Fiverr Pro (formerly Fiverr Business) provides curated access to top-tier talent with enhanced collaboration tools and project management features.
